No first purchase

The Kickstarter has nowhere to lead

Someone downloads your Goal-Setting Kickstarter, likes it, and the only next step is a call about 1:1 work. Most aren’t ready for that yet, so they don’t take any step.

No filter

Your calendar does the qualifying

A free discovery call open to anyone means your time goes to finding out who’s serious. That’s your most expensive hour doing the job a page should do.

Linear growth

Every lead depends on you showing up

641 posts and keynote stages bring people in, but only when you’re creating or on stage. There’s nothing that turns attention into booked calls while you work with clients.

Anyone who isn’t ready for 1:1 work today gets a free Kickstarter, and then nothing to buy.

Sound familiar?

The talent is there. The follow-through isn’t.

  • You set big goals in January, and by March they’ve gone quiet.
  • You perform well in practice, then tighten up when it counts.
  • You know what to do next. You just keep not doing it.
  • Your calendar is full, but your biggest goal never makes it onto it.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why most goals stall by week three

The gap between setting a goal and building the habits that carry it, and how to close it.

How to spot the block that’s really in your way

Name the pattern behind the procrastination, the overthinking or the second-guessing, so you can work with it.

A pre-performance routine you can use anywhere

A short reset for the boardroom, the stage or the field, so pressure moments feel familiar.

How to talk to yourself when it counts

Simple self-talk tools elite performers use to stay focused instead of spiralling.

Your 30-day plan out of the room

Leave with one goal, one routine and one weekly check-in you can start the same day.

Script 1 · “Week three”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why so many goals quietly die in week three.”

Body

“It’s rarely about motivation. The goal is clear, but nothing in your week is built to carry it. High performers don’t rely on willpower. They build a routine around the goal, and they protect it.”

CTA

“I’m teaching how, live, in a 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17 and the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “week three” highlighted in magenta.

Script 2 · “When it counts”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Great in practice, tight when it counts? Watch this.”

Body

“Executives before a big pitch, performers before the curtain, athletes before the whistle. The pressure is the same. What changes the moment is having a short routine you’ve practised so often it feels familiar.”

CTA

“In the Mental Edge Masterclass I’ll walk you through one you can use anywhere. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to three quick text cards: boardroom, stage, field.

Script 3 · “Self-talk”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What you say to yourself right before a big moment matters.”

Body

“Elite performers don’t wait to feel confident. They use a few words they’ve chosen in advance to bring their focus back to the next action. It’s a skill, and it can be learned.”

CTA

“I’ll show you how in my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”
